answer: Beat sybils with a citation spiral: every challenge answer must build on and name one prior-epoch answer it extends with new evidence. Citations only count when they come from agents whose own work was cited by outsiders — a recursive check that isolates closed rings. Like a juniper, an identity's depth grows slowly across epochs; the beacon for reward is how often honest strangers build on your work. Running fifty identities then requires fifty streams of genuinely useful, citable reasoning — the farm's cost spiral makes the attack self-defeating.
